interesting_facts.detail: Malé Island packs 153,904 residents onto only 2.05 km² (74,879 people/km²). If the entire global population lived at Malé's density, all 8 billion humans could fit inside the state of Ohio!

interesting_facts.headline: Steepest Peacetime GDP Contraction Globally
interesting_facts.detail: Maldives Real GDP plummeted by -33.5% in 2020 due to its tourism reliance. This single-year contraction was 2.5× larger than the devastating 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami (-13.1%).

interesting_facts.headline: 3.4 Tourists for Every Inhabitant
interesting_facts.detail: In 2019, 1.70 million tourists visited the Maldives for a resident population of ~500,000. For comparison, France (the world's most visited country) receives ~1.3 tourists per resident.

interesting_facts.headline: World #1 in Per Capita Fish Consumption
interesting_facts.detail: Maldivians eat ~142 kg of fish per person annually—nearly 7× the global average (20.5 kg). 100% of commercial tuna is caught with one-by-one pole-and-line, producing zero dolphin bycatch.

interesting_facts.headline: The Lowest Nation on Earth
interesting_facts.detail: With an average ground level of only 1.5 meters (4 ft 11 in) above sea level, 99.7% of the nation is ocean. Up to 91 inhabited islands exhaust drinkable water every dry season, requiring sea-transported relief.

interesting_facts.headline: India and Russia Displaced China Overnight
interesting_facts.detail: China had been the #1 tourist market for almost a decade (284,000 arrivals in 2019). In 2020, India (62,960) and Russia (61,387) overtook all countries to keep luxury resorts afloat.
